description: Chooses which client activity you hear about (qualified leads, a caller texted one of a client's links, a client needing attention) and where those alerts go. With no emails set, alerts go to the agency owners. Requires an agency owner or admin. Changes future alerts only.

emails.description: Up to 5 emails for the alerts; an empty list sends them to the agency owners.

phone.description: A phone that also gets the alerts by text; null stops the texts.

name: agency_clients_set_activity_alerts
title: Set Your Client Activity Alerts
